title: Warm Venezuelan Beef Stew
description: A savory and gooey Venezuelan dish featuring beef, brandy, and vegetables cooked in a clay pot, wrapped in a lotus leaf for a unique flavor and presentation. This dish is perfect for a lazy Sunday
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large clay pot, heat the brandy over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef brisket to the pot and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot, along with the tomato paste, beef broth, salt, and pepper.
Stir the stew well, then cover the pot with a lid.
Wrap the clay pot in the lotus leaves, making sure to seal the edges well.
Place the pot in the oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
